decisions.text: docs/status.json is the machine-readable state for agent iterations. docs/DECISIONS.md and docs/MILESTONES.md (spec §0) are written from it at each milestone completion.
Spec copied to docs/SPEC.md so iterations don't depend on ~/Downloads.
Agent workflow: plan mode per milestone; haiku subagents for fully-specified mechanical subtasks; lead model for rules/architecture. Recorded in CLAUDE.md.

Spec-first OpenAPI: docs/openapi.yaml is hand-written; oapi-codegen (chi strict server + embedded spec) generates Go, openapi-typescript + openapi-fetch generate packages/api-client. Drift check = make gen + git diff.
Requests validated against the OpenAPI spec by kin-openapi middleware (trust boundary). Errors are RFC 9457 with stable `code`; services return *platform.Problem.
npm workspaces instead of pnpm (already installed). Go tools (sqlc, oapi-codegen, golangci-lint) run pinned via `go run` from the Makefile: no global installs.
Migrations live in db/migrations (golang-migrate files); `api migrate` applies them plus River's schema. Compose runs it as a one-shot service before api/worker; DO runs it as a PRE_DEPLOY job.
Each milestone adds only the tables it needs (M0: users, email_codes, refresh_tokens, email_provider_usage, config, audit_log). Seed grows per milestone; M0 seeds users + super admin only.
auth_providers stored as nullable apple_sub / google_sub columns, not a separate table.
Signup takes all §4.1 mandatory fields already in M0 (same endpoint). Under-18 rejected with code `underage` before any write. Home location snapped to a 0.005° grid (~500 m).

Tokens: HS256 access JWT 15 min with audience `app` or `admin`; opaque refresh tokens (30 days) stored as HMAC-SHA256; rotation per use; presenting a used token revokes the whole family. Password reset revokes all sessions.
Email codes (verify/reset) are HMAC'd with the server secret; attempts are counted before checking (committed even on failure), max 5, 15 min TTL.

OAuth: Apple/Google ID tokens verified with go-oidc against issuer JWKS. Known sub logs in; a provider-verified email that matches an existing account links it; unknown accounts get 422 profile_required and resend with profile. Unconfigured provider returns 503 provider_not_configured.

Admin: users.role = super_admin plus totp_secret. /admin/v1/auth/login needs password + TOTP and issues admin-audience tokens. Every admin request re-checks the role in the DB. Admin web keeps tokens in memory only.

Email goes through a River job (send_code_email). Failover sender walks EMAIL_PROVIDERS in order with daily caps from the email_provider_usage table; when every provider is capped the job snoozes 1 h. `console` provider logs emails in dev.
DeviceChecker interface with a NoDeviceCheck stub until Apple DeviceCheck / Play Integrity credentials exist. A flagged device sends signups to status pending_review (M1 DoD).
Object storage locally is SeaweedFS (S3 API on :8333): MinIO no longer publishes Docker images. Prod/staging uses DO Spaces.
Auth rate limit: 20 req/min per client IP on /auth/* paths, in memory. The client IP comes from RemoteAddr, or from X-Forwarded-For when TRUSTED_PROXIES is greater than 0.
Mobile: access token in memory, refresh token in expo-secure-store; a 401 triggers one refresh and retry. Signup home area uses device location in M0; the map pin picker comes with M1 maps.
TERMS_VERSION is duplicated in packages/i18n and the server env (default 2026-10). A forced re-acceptance flow is M1 scope (§8).

findings.text: Local toolchain: go 1.26.5, node 26.7, npm 11.19, make 3.81, Docker 29.8 (on PATH only via ~/.zshrc; agent shells need PATH=$HOME/.docker/bin:$PATH). No Xcode, no Android SDK.
Parallel subagents running `npm install` in the same workspace corrupted node_modules (ENOTEMPTY, missing files). Fixed with `npm ci`. Rule added to CLAUDE.md: npm installs are serialized.
postgis image healthcheck must use TCP (`pg_isready -h localhost`): the init-time server is socket-only, so a socket check passes too early and migrate fails with connection refused.
Expo SDK 57 / RN 0.86 / React 19.2 with React Compiler lint rules: refs read in render-time closures are flagged. The session keeps the API client and access token at module scope.
chi RealIP and httprate.LimitByIP/Limit are deprecated (spoofing). Use middleware.ClientIPFrom* + httprate.LimitBy.
